title: Pearlmoor Quay - Festival of the Floating Lights
_note: Festival variant. gbc 4-voice, no chords. 116 BPM, 3/4, F major, bright. Lively waltz - the Vesper motif ORNAMENTED with quick grace-note runs (sixteenths), celebratory; the town's hook in its happiest dress. Harmony = busier Tide bell-buoy chimes + bright Light sparkle on phrase ends. Bass = bouncier waltz with a little sixteenth anticipation into beat 1. Percussion = light noise brush on 1 + cheerful tambourine-style hat on 2&3, a fill at the seam. 24-bar loop ~37s.

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: Waltz Vesper in F ornamented with quick sixteenth grace runs, festive. lift C4->F4->G4, settle A4->G4->F4. Final bar leans on C (V) into bar 1.
